evidence.text:
Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
40%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Moderately reduced Ieft ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 274 mg/dL (H)
LDL Cholesterol: 175 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 50 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 245 mg/dL (H)

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Caardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
